messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
As of which date does Article 50(1) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which requires Member States to lay down penalties, become applicable?

response.text: A partire da quale data diventa applicabile l'articolo 50, paragrafo 1, del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230, che impone agli Stati membri di stabilire le sanzioni?
